digest.component_or_area: LLM framework structured output and prompt caching
propositions: Direct Anthropic structured call over identical cache-eligible prefix produces observable cache write on first call (10697 tokens) and cache read on second call (10697 tokens), with single request and well-formed output per call

Direct Bedrock structured call over identical cache-eligible prefix produces observable cache write on first call (10685 tokens) and cache read on second call (10685 tokens), with single request and well-formed output per call
Both provider arms exercise complete-response branch (1 message in, 1 kept, 0 omitted) on every request; omit branch remains unexercised as expected on happy path with no failed intermediate outputs

Observed usage accounting matches contract in docs/llm-framework.md for all exercised counts: one outer run per call, requests=1 on well-formed first response, output retry allowance=2 with zero consumed, cache tokens cleanly alternate between write/read columns

Mixed-provider fallback chain collapses prompt caching to none due to incompatible cache keys between providers, creating gap between documented accounting section and observed gate-run zero cache counts
